tools.name: grade_centering
tools.description: Convert known card centering ratios into the maximum grade permitted by centering at PSA, BGS, CGC and SGC. Use for questions such as “is 58/42 a PSA 10?” without needing a photo. Accept reversed ratios and percentages. At least one axis is required. Missing axes or faces may lower the ceiling; neve

tools.name: get_centering_standards
tools.description: Look up card centering thresholds for PSA, BGS, CGC and SGC, optionally by house and front/back. Use for threshold/rules questions and source checks. Returns per-band official/interpreted/approximate status, source links, verification date/provenance and rounding rule. TAG is excluded. These are cen

tools.name: measure_card_centering
tools.description: Measure worst-station left/right and top/bottom card centering from one photograph. Ask front or back before calling. Request a whole card, flat on a dark surface, straight from above and out of its sleeve. The photo is processed on the server in memory and discarded, unlike the local-only website.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "measure_card_centering" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Measure worst-station left/right and top/bottom card centering from one photograph. Ask front or back before calling. Request a whole card, flat on a dark surfa…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "grade_centering" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
